source: TASK-018 implementation from validated planning build.

task.title: Implement deferred-decision trigger reconciliation
task.summary: Extend planning propagation gates so explicit deferrals stop being treated as resolved after their trigger is satisfied, using the post-agency file-structure deferral as the regression fixture.

goal.outcome: A deferred accepted decision cannot remain invisible after its trigger is satisfied; planning validation, graph/status reconciliation, and alignment audit route trigger-satisfied deferrals back to planning until resolved.
acceptance: Recover and cite the original file-structure planning-gateway failure: the 2026-05-22 planning pass allowed accepted downstream work to remain only in open questions/prose deferrals.
Confirm TASK-011 fixed unmapped decision rows for future builds and identify the remaining trigger-materialization gap for explicit deferrals.
Decision propagation assessment can represent deferred row/question trigger state, or equivalent source evidence, without breaking existing planning build callers.

When source truth shows a deferral trigger is satisfied and no renewed deferral/task/sprint/knowledge-only completion exists, graph reconciliation/status and alignment audit expose a planning residual instead of reporting no actionable work.

Planning validation/preflight blocks a pass for trigger-satisfied deferred rows unless the planning build creates tasks/sprint metadata, records knowledge-only completion, or renews deferral with updated owner/trigger/rationale.
A smoke or fixture test based on TASK-014/TASK-015 proves agency-pilot-close triggers follow-up planning, while not-yet-satisfied explicit deferrals remain non-blocking.
File-structure KB/diagram record agency pilot validated and deferred-root trigger satisfied; no source migration or shim removal happens in this task.
non_goals: Do not choose or implement the next concept-root migration boundary in this task.
Do not move audit/build/validation/session/state/roadmap/project/knowledge/gateway/GC source files in this task.
Do not remove agency compatibility shims in this task.
Do not change public commands, package entrypoints, adapter schemas, or product behavior.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

requirements.text: Trigger-satisfied deferred decision rows/questions must become unresolved planning residuals until resolved by task/sprint/knowledge-only or renewed deferral.
File-structure diagram can provide satisfied deferred trigger evidence for TASK-014/TASK-015 post-agency regression.
Planning tool schemas accept optional trigger_state without breaking callers.
No concept-root source migration or agency shim removal occurs in TASK-018.
